title: First Demonstration of a 200×200 mm2 Glass Substrate for Large Area Packages

title: Glass-Stacked Interposers with Microdispensed Silver Nanopaste for Low-Temperature 3D Interconnection
notes: Borosilicate slide + 150 um coverslips, fs-laser vias (400 um design), microdispensed US-202A traces, CL83A via fill/interlayer adhesive; resistivity, via R, tape test.

title: Metallization Challenges: Conformable Deposition for Super High-Aspect Ratio (> 100) Fine TGV and Cu Pillar Embedment for 1-mm-Deep Fat TGV
notes: 1 mm glass, 40x40 TGV arrays 10-100 um (AR 10-100, 250 um pitch): EL-Ni seed, Ti/Cu, double-sided Cu plating (seams remain); 74 um Cu pillar inserted in 100 um TGV with resin.

title: Digital Lithography Patterning of Novel Dry Film Resists for High Aspect Ratio Cu Pillar Applications on 310×310mm2 Panel Substrates
notes: Maskless 375/405 nm exposure of 120 um CX-series dry film resist on glass panels and Si wafer; CDU +/-4%, 30/40 um vias, 110 um Cu pillars AR 1:4/1:3. Exposure platform named LITHOSCALE.

title: Game-Changing Nanosolder Technology: Self-Assembling Adhesives for Sub-10 µm Ultra-Fine Interconnects

notes: Sn nanosolder self-assembling adhesive on Si test chips: bumping at 40/10 um pitch, chip-to-chip bonding at 20/10 um pitch (hot plate ~0 pressure, TCB 0.5/1.0 N); SEM/EDS/XRM, DSC, die shear 20-23 MPa.
